about_the_game:
In the borderlands of Camelot, legends whisper on every wind. But when the Ashen Knight and his dragon turn your home to ash, the fairy tale becomes a war. All you have left is the will to survive—and the desire to uncover the truth about your past.

Your journey will lead into the heart of a cursed fortress, where an ancient oath between knights and dragons waits to be restored… or destroyed.

🔹 Explore enchanting yet dangerous lands—from flooded caves to burning citadels.

🔹 Discover hidden objects and clues that lead to Camelot’s buried secrets.

🔹 Challenge the Ashen Knights and break the chains that bind dragons.

🔹 Solve intricate puzzles to reveal legends and long-forgotten truths.

🔹 Become the hero of the legend—or its final casualty.

Beyond the cursed walls, an ancient darkness stirs… and it already knows your name…
